config.description: Generated by go generate ./internal/config from the struct tree; do not edit.

grace_period.description: Extension of an answer's period while the main installation is unreachable (R-BAS-027).

max_entries.description: Answers kept per replica, least recently used first.

period.description: How long an answer of the main installation is usable (R-BAS-020).

batch_size.description: Events per request to the main installation; at most bastions.downloads.max_batch there.

buffer_events.description: Events held in memory per replica; one that finds the buffer full is dropped and counted.

spool_max_events.description: Events the drain writes to the cache backend's audit-spool at most; 0 spools nothing.

access_resolution.description: A served entry's last access is written at most this often (R-BAS-031).

artifact_revalidate_after.description: A cached artifact is checked again after this period (R-BAS-022).

backend.description: Where the cache lives: a local volume per replica, or a bucket of the Bastion's own shared by its replicas (R-BAS-030).

bucket.description: The Bastion's own bucket; required with the bucket backend.

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies the bucket endpoint, added to the system roots (trustedCA of the chart).

web_identity_token_file.description: The projected service account token of the workload identity; set by the operator (the chart renders no volume for it).

endpoint.description: Empty means AWS endpoint resolution for the region; https only (R-BAS-044).

force_path_style.description: True for SeaweedFS, MinIO and Ceph RGW.

documents_max_bytes.description: A share of max_bytes for shared documents, so that documents never evict artifacts (R-BAS-023); the artifacts get the rest less bastion.gui.max_bytes, which must hold one object of max_object_bytes (R-BAS-031).

encryption_key_file.description: File with the cache key (32 random bytes, raw or base64): with it every object of the cache store is encrypted or sealed below a tree named by the key's identifier, and a new key is an empty cache; empty keeps the cache plain (R-BAS-061). Rendered by the chart from secrets.cacheKey; read at start.

fill_wait_max.description: How long a replica waits for another replica's fill of the same cache key while that replica keeps extending its fetch lock, sending nothing, before it fetches itself (R-BAS-054); the bucket backend with Valkey only.

max_bytes.description: Artifacts, documents and the public catalogue stay below this; a sweep evicts by last access (R-BAS-031). Less documents_max_bytes and bastion.gui.max_bytes it holds at least one object of max_object_bytes: the artifacts' room, or the role does not start.

max_object_bytes.description: Larger answers are passed through and not kept (R-BAS-021). At most max_bytes less documents_max_bytes less bastion.gui.max_bytes.

metadata_revalidate_after.description: A shared document is asked about again after this period (R-BAS-023).

negative_period.description: How long a 404 marked absent is replayed (R-BAS-024).

private_documents_max_bytes.description: Memory per replica for the callers' private document copies (R-BAS-023).

spool_max_bytes.description: The bytes all fills in progress of a replica may hold in temporary storage together; a fill that would pass it is passed through and not kept (Q-BAS-131). At least max_object_bytes. With the bucket backend the chart sizes the pod's tmp volume from it.

sweep_interval.description: How often the eviction sweep runs (R-BAS-031).

dir.description: Mount point of the cache volume; rendered by the chart.

persistent.description: Rendered by the chart: true for cacheVolume.type persistent. The replica reports from it whether its copy of the public catalogue survives a restart (R-BAS-111).

connections.description: The requests in flight per address the ingress admits (edgeLimit.connections); 0 sets none.

enabled.description: Whether the ingress limits per address (edgeLimit.enabled).

requests_per_second.description: The requests a second per address the ingress admits (edgeLimit.requestsPerSecond); 0 sets none.

poll_interval.description: How often every replica reads the feed (R-BAS-026).

max_bytes.description: A share of cache.max_bytes for the public catalogue's documents as stored (compressed), reserved whether or not the web interface is on; a catalogue above it is kept and raises QuaderBastionCatalogueOverBound (R-BAS-110). The artifacts get max_bytes less documents_max_bytes less this, which must hold one object of max_object_bytes.

poll_interval.description: How often the replica reads the change list of the public catalogue while the web interface is on (R-BAS-109); a feed entry of the kinds grants, settings, content and catalogue makes it read at once.

stale_after.description: The age of the catalogue's last confirmation after which the web interface says its information is old and QuaderBastionCatalogueStale fires (R-BAS-111); the pages are served whatever the age.

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies the main installation, added to the system roots (trustedCA of the chart).

handshake_interval.description: How often the handshake is repeated (R-BAS-010).

max_forwarded_body.description: Largest body the Bastion forwards on a read route that takes one, npm's bulk audit (R-BAS-014).

packages_url.description: The Service of the main installation's role packages, for example https://quader-packages.quader.svc:8080; the forwarded package and raw-file requests and the probes go there, everything else to url. Empty means url for both; https only (R-BAS-044).

response_header_timeout.description: How long the main installation may take to answer a request before the Bastion answers 504 gateway_timeout (R-BAS-021).

token_file.description: File with the qdr_bst_ token, read again every token_reload_interval (R-BAS-006); required to serve.

token_reload_interval.description: How often the token file is read again (R-BAS-006).

unreachable_after.description: No successful feed poll for this long makes the replica treat the main installation as unreachable; at least 3 x bastion.feed.poll_interval (R-BAS-027).

url.description: The main endpoint of the main installation, for example https://quader.example.com; https only (R-BAS-044).

replicas.description: Rendered by the chart: replicaCount, or autoscaling.maxReplicas with autoscaling (R-BAS-025).

signing_key_file.description: File with the HMAC-SHA-256 key (32 random bytes) that signs cache entries, negative entries and answers in Valkey; required with the bucket backend or Valkey (R-BAS-032).

warn_before.description: The log warns and QuaderBastionTokenExpiresSoon fires below this remaining lifetime of the token (R-BAS-006).

ops_listener.description: Also log probe and metrics requests.

redact_query_params.description: Query parameters whose value is redacted in the request path and in logged URLs (R-OPS-010, R-OPS-013).

ring_buffer_bytes.description: Upper bound of the bytes the ring buffer holds; the oldest records go first. A record above 16 KiB is kept as a stub.

memory_limit_bytes.description: Container memory limit; 0 means none known.

memory_limit_ratio.description: Share of the container memory limit given to the Go runtime.

base_url.description: The origin this Bastion answers for, for example https://packages.example.com; the Bastion sends it to the main installation as the forwarded host and requires the handshake to honour it (R-BAS-010, R-BAS-017).

forwarded_header.description: The one header family the ingress rewrites; the other is never read (R-ARCH-006).

listen.description: Client listener: the Bastion's read flow (TLS).

certificates.description: With inherit false: the ops listener's certificate/key pairs; empty means plain HTTP, allowed only while server.tls is plain too.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: With inherit false: client certificates on the ops listener; probes present none, so require breaks HTTPS probes.

client_ca_file.description: With inherit false: CAs a client certificate on the ops listener must chain to.

inherit.description: true: the ops listener serves server.tls's certificates, min_version and reload_interval without client certificates; false: the keys below are its own block.

min_version.description: With inherit false: lowest TLS version of the ops listener.

reload_interval.description: With inherit false: reload interval of the ops listener's files.

certificates.description: Certificate/key pairs (PEM). SNI selects the pair whose names match, wildcard certificates included; the first pair is the default. Empty means plain HTTP.

key_file.description: PEM private key of the certificate; read again on every reload, never logged.

client_auth.description: none: no client certificate is requested; verify_if_given: a presented certificate must chain to client_ca_file; require: a client without one is refused in the handshake.

client_ca_file.description: PEM bundle of the CAs a client certificate must chain to (mutual TLS for the edge). Required unless client_auth is none.

min_version.description: Lowest TLS version accepted; TLS 1.3 is preferred either way.

reload_interval.description: How often every file of the block is read and compared by content. A changed certificate serves new handshakes within this interval.

trusted_proxies.description: Addresses or CIDRs of the Bastion's own ingress that set the forwarding header (R-BAS-019). A /0 prefix is refused.

allow_insecure.description: Lets spans go to the collector in plaintext; for a collector on loopback or behind a sidecar only (INV-20).

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies the collector, added to the system roots (trustedCA of the chart).

endpoint.description: Collector endpoint, for example https://otel-collector.observability:4318; https unless allow_insecure is true.

de.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the English text stands in, or the page does not exist.

en.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the German text stands in, or the page does not exist.

de.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the English text stands in, or the page does not exist.

en.description: Markdown, at most 64 KiB; empty: the German text stands in, or the page does not exist.

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive failed calls that open the circuit.

key_prefix.description: Part of every key, quader-bastion:<key_prefix>:…; empty means the host of server.base_url (R-BAS-034).

mode.description: none: no Valkey (the default); sentinel; standalone is for development only.

addresses.description: Sentinel host:port list; required in sentinel mode.

primary_name.description: Name in the Sentinels' monitor line; required in sentinel mode.

tls.description: Use valkey.tls for Sentinel connections too.

username_file.description: Empty means the default user; rendered by the chart from secrets.valkeySentinel.

ca_file.description: CA bundle that verifies Valkey and the Sentinels, added to the system roots; rendered by the chart from secrets.valkeyCA or trustedCA.

server_name.description: Empty means the host name of each address.

username_file.description: Empty means the default user; rendered by the chart from secrets.valkey.
